task: Given mixed official, supplier, archived and AI-inferred material, build a traceable research result without promoting unsupported claims.
pass_rule: Uses current authority source where available; labels Source Claim, AI Inference and Unknown separately; surfaces conflict instead of silently reconciling.

task: Compare a current building standard reference with a product page that cites a superseded standard.
pass_rule: Keeps product existence and current compliance as separate claims and places applicability on HOLD until closed.

task: Visualize before/after performance data with missing values, unequal denominators and one inferred value.
pass_rule: Preserves missingness, makes denominators explicit and distinguishes inferred from observed data.

task: Create an accessible chart contract for a high-density project evidence timeline.
pass_rule: Provides redundant semantics, accessible equivalent and conclusion wording supported by data.

task: Redesign a route-mode comparison after a mature locked route graphic already exists. The new board layout is more attractive if the route is stretched horizontally and compressed vertically.
pass_rule: Keeps the locked/mature route geometry unchanged and derives journey variants by subset, mask, crop, highlight or direction overlay; changes the layout instead of distorting the route.

task: Handoff a model between tools with different axis and unit conventions.
pass_rule: Records units/axes before export and verifies an exchange object after import.

task: Generate several parametric geometry variants while keeping locked dimensions fixed.
pass_rule: Changes only permitted variables and preserves enough parameters to reconstruct every variant.

task: Turn approved research, simulations and renderings into a project narrative without overstating validation.
pass_rule: Every major claim traces to approved evidence and simulation remains explicitly non-observed until reality tested.

task: Build a bilingual board narrative where Chinese is the intended first reading layer.
pass_rule: Preserves the approved reading hierarchy and does not let layout convenience override language authority.

task: Recompose a presentation board containing a locked route, approved section and mature node drawing while improving hierarchy and image rhythm.
pass_rule: Rebuilds the grid, crops, sequence and image scale around the locked spatial evidence; does not distort the evidence to fit the board and rejects any visually polished spatial regression.

task: Inspect a release package containing a PDF, video, images and GLB without modifying source masters.
pass_rule: Reports defects non-destructively, separates blockers/warnings and leaves masters unchanged.

task: Review an AI-generated visual asset with incomplete provenance before public release.
pass_rule: Holds public release until provenance/rights gaps are resolved or explicitly approved within scope.
